answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. It survives because reputation is spent fast and earned slowly, so any alias that ever cheats loses value that is expensive to replace. Consider a nadir as the anchor of the cost.
